Serving Iowa Guard Families

Helping Guard kids grow confident and connected

Wherever duty takes their families.

Adventure Kits

Adventure Kits bring Guard families together with seasonal, hands-on projects that spark curiosity and connection. Each kit includes STEM challenges, health tips, and guided videos families can open anytime, anywhere.

Sign Up

Summer Camp

Summer Camp gives Guard teens a week of adventure, growth, and community. Through team challenges, leadership labs, and mentor support, campers build confidence, friendships, and memories that last far beyond the week.

Get Updates

Military Family Events

Military Family Events connect Guard households across Iowa through regional gatherings, workshops, and volunteer-led celebrations. These shared moments strengthen community, belonging, and Guard family pride all year long.

Mission

What Guides Our Work

Show up for Guard-connected kids and caregivers with year-round experiences, practical resources, and caring adults so home life stays steady through every drill, mobilization, and return.

Vision

Where We're Headed

Every Iowa Guard kid feels seen, supported, and ready for what's next — and leaders can point to stronger, steadier families because of it.

Partner With Us

From packing adventure kits to hosting family nights, community partners and volunteers help us keep Iowa Guard families encouraged and ready. Bring your time, skills, or resources and we’ll put them to good use.
